featured_reviews.name: Anuprita Khanvilkar
featured_reviews.review_text:
I hired 3 times different house help for my blind 86 yrs old Dad but my experience unfortunately was not that good. First male attendant would come 15-20 mins late every day but leave on time. One day is fine but every day same issue so we changed because he took two days leave and informed last moment where we had to accommodate on our own, then we asked for second boy who was illiterate and couldn’t read or use mobile. Though he was good in his work but he was fainted the first day of his work because he said he had low BP issues. Then he started going out for lunch because his house was under repairs and his mom didn’t give him food. When I chose to offer him food he said he likes spicy and not medium spicy food. He also took leaves unfortunately because he was unwell and planning to do some fasts. I immediately asked for a change because one day he ate his lunch late he fainted and then he said he wants to fast 40 days without water and food. Third attendant Francis who came from Nalasopara was heart patient and had brain surgery done on himself and was diabetic too. He took care of my dad but not ready to wash his bedsheets weekly and said he has shoulder pain and he is heart patient. I have a humble request here Brian Sir, whenever you hire male attendants please get their health checkup done because you are placing them with senior citizens who are completely dependent on them. They have this Attitude of not doing any work, don’t know to use mobile - saying I am
Not educated or do Basic cleaning of the patient bedsheets weekly.  My dad used to have his bath on own though be was blind by his instincts because he was in defence services- Ex Navy, eat on own only we needed the attendant to serve him and wash his plate. He used to come everyday at 7.25am but leave by 7.15 pm saying Virar train has rush. We never bothered because my dad was used to being alone for sometime but always cribbing to do things and unhappy with anything we say is not acceptable. We had read the reviews and chose your agency but my experience was not that good at the three times. Maybe in future if we need anyone hope to get someone better. Brian Sir I have huge respect for you and Sanjeev Sir but your attendants unfortunately were not able to maintain the standards here.

featured_reviews.name: Satya Purohit
featured_reviews.review_text:
Our parents recently spent a short stay at Sahabhaav, and we were deeply impressed by the warmth, attentiveness, and professionalism of the entire team. The facility is modern, cheerful, and comfortable, the food was excellent, and the social activities helped our parents feel engaged and included. Minor issues were addressed promptly, creating a sense of ease throughout their stay. What stood out most is the genuine care that defines Sahabhaav. It is clear that for Dr Mini Panicker and her team, this work is truly a calling. Details on different aspects follow.

Exceptional Team and Warmth:
The staff's engagement made a tremendous difference. Our parents repeatedly said, "Anything we asked for, they got for us," which reflects how well they were looked after.

Social Interaction and Activities:
The range of activities, from casual storytelling sessions to aarti and seated garba, added real value. These thoughtful experiences help seniors feel connected and uplifted, especially those with limited mobility.

Facilities and Ambience:
The interiors have been newly renovated with a modern, airy, cheerful aesthetic that creates a welcoming atmosphere. The bathrooms are well designed with modern fittings and pleasant colors.

Food and Dining:
The meals were another highlight. Dad enjoyed the variety of vegetarian dishes, lentils, yogurt, buttermilk, and the occasional chicken. Mom, who is usually a selective eater, also managed very well, which speaks to the quality of the food and the adaptability of tastes.

Freedom From Household Responsibilities:
For Mom, the relief from day to day household tasks was meaningful. She appreciated being cared for rather than needing to manage everything herself.

Responsiveness:
As with any new place and the specific needs of individual guests, minor issues can arise, but what stood out was how promptly and proactively the Sahabhaav team addressed them.

Overall Experience:
Our parents' stay was overwhelmingly positive, and we are grateful for the compassion and professionalism shown throughout. Sahabhaav offers a warm, community driven environment that places seniors' comfort and dignity at the center. We deeply appreciate the efforts of everyone at Sahabhaav and wish the facility continued success and its residents the very best.
